title: Compare the universal equation and differential with the tensor of local first jets
statement: Use the smooth source f:Y -> Spec k, invertible L, finite sections s_i, source open U and point z, frame e on W containing U.ι(z), actual singular fibre T, coordinate map rho and local jets of [lem-zl-bertini-singular-fibre-coordinates] and [lem-zl-bertini-local-first-jets]. Let p be the ambient projection from coefficient affine space times Y, M the tensor pullback of L, V the inverse image of W, and g:T -> coefficient affine space times Y the canonical composite [def-zl-bertini-universal-family]. Then g maps T into V, and there is a free generator ep of M on V. Let F be the coefficient of the restricted universal section in ep. There is an injective additive map J from Gamma(T,O_T) tensor over kappa_U(z) (kappa_U(z) plus bertiniCotangentFibre f U z) into Gamma(T,O_T) times Gamma(T,g^*Omega_p). This map sends the sum of rho(X_i) tensor the local first jets of the e-coefficients of s_i to the pair consisting of g^*F and g^*(dF), restricted to the top open. This is an identity of sections, asserting no vanishing and using no nonsmoothness criterion.

proof.text: Use uniqueness of left adjoints to transfer the ordinary pullback free-generator theorem to the section-normalized tensor pullback. Naturality of its unit and the coefficient identity give F=sum_i x_i pr_Y^*(a_i). This is proved in the private helpers tensor_unit_free and tensor_frame_expansion.

The fibre square and restriction inclusion give g followed by the source projection = h followed by the residue-point morphism and U inclusion. This proves the image is in V. Evaluate the coordinate-map projection identity on X_i and use naturality of GammaSpecIso to identify g^*x_i with rho(X_i). Evaluate source sections through the residue-point morphism to identify g^*a with the value part of its local jet, using rho(C) as scalar action.

Apply the source-fibre differential-sections comparison to obtain an injective A-linear D on A tensor the cotangent fibre, with its formula on differential germs. Combine D with tensor cancellation A tensor K = A and tensor distribution over a product to construct J; injectivity follows from injectivity of its two components.

The relative derivation kills restrictions of every coordinate pulled back from the coefficient base. Leibniz and additivity therefore express the pulled-back derivative of F as sum_i rho(X_i) times the pulled-back derivative of pr_Y^*a_i. Apply the pure-tensor formula of D termwise; the value calculation proves the other component. This gives the unchanged displayed pair.

theorem exists_bertini_fibre_jet_comparison
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (s : I → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (U : Y.Opens) (z : U) (W : Y.Opens) (hz : U.ι z ∈ W)
    (e : Γ(L, W)) (he : Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator e) :
    let c := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* MvPolynomial I k))
    let p := pullback.fst c f
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd c f)).obj L
    let V := (pullback.snd c f) ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let t := (bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiberι z ≫
      ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
    let j := (bertiniSingularIdeal f L s).subschemeι ≫
      (bertiniUniversalIdeal f L s).subschemeι
    let g := t ≫ j
    let K := (U : Scheme).residueField z
    let A := Γ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiber z, ⊤)
    let ρ := bertiniSingularFibreRingMap f L s U z
    letI : Algebra K A := (ρ.comp MvPolynomial.C).toAlgebra
    ∃ (hV : (⊤ : ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiber z).Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (ep : Γ(M, V)) (hep : Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator ep),
      let F := hep.coeff (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        (bertiniUniversalSection f L s))
      ∃ J : (A ⊗[K] (K × bertiniCotangentFibre f U z)) →+
          (A × Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj p.relativeDifferentials, ⊤)),
        Function.Injective J ∧
        J (∑ i, ρ (MvPolynomial.X i) ⊗ₜ[K]
          bertiniLocalFirstJet f U z W hz
            (he.coeff (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (s i)))) =
          (g.appLE V ⊤ hV F,
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj p.relativeDifferentials).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE hV).op (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection g p.relativeDifferentials
                V (p.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := Opposite.op V) F)))
